title: New in Symfony 8.2: HTTP Trailers
content:
<html><head></head><body>HTTP trailers are header fields that servers send after the response body.
They are useful when a value is only known once the whole body has been generated,
like a checksum of the content or the final status of a streamed operation. The
best-known example…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
